rules: Coverage audit ONLY,three preselected existing R6III photos ISO1000/25600/64000,fresh RCD+FlatOnly neutral master and whole-frame production50 reference. Firstdark/flat/detail crops64 from existing selector,centre31. No NLM/pilot or new denoising parameter. Source hashes checked against prior spectral provenance. Also normalized pair highpass cross-energy from saved original pair samples,no RAW pair rerun.
limitations: Unpaired photos have no clean truth. Highpass energy mixes signal/noise;no retained-detail/noise-removal or perceptual score claimed. Selected labels do not certify natural feature content.Paired coherence may reflect nonlinear/shared structure and unstable low energy. Audit before any further denoiser comparison;no production changes,no TIFF.
